About Stockyard's

A Cut Above the Ordinary

Stockyard's isn't just a restaurant — it's an experience built from the ground up to deliver great food, great drinks, and great nights in the heart of downtown Fredericksburg. We brought the boldness of a western steakhouse into the soul of a local bar where everybody belongs.

Whether you're here for a sizzling 48oz Tomahawk, a moonshine cocktail on the porch, or a night out with live music filling the room — this is the place. Come as you are. Leave full and happy.

Behind the Bar

Drink Something Unforgettable

Handcrafted cocktails, Virginia moonshine, wine, and cold draft beer. The bar is open — what'll it be?

01
Front Porch Tea

Kick your boots off at the end of the day with a Tito's spiked sweet tea. Available in flavors or tea/lemonade.

Peach Raspberry Strawberry Watermelon Blueberry
02
Gold Rush

Richmond's very own Virago Gin is liquid gold with honey and orange. Sweet enough to keep the bees away from the horses.

03
June Bug

The bug juice everyone can't resist. Fruity and refreshing with a coconut finish.

04
Outlaw Nightcap

Settle in for the night with an orange and lime twist to a whiskey comfort.

05
Ranch Water

Need we say more. The cleanest, crispest refresher on the menu.

06
Pendleton Barrel Aged Old Fashion

A true campfire classic. A standard old fashioned made with Pendleton Whiskey — barrel aged in house for a perfect sweet finish.
